BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC has purchased 423,072 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between July 6th and July 10th, 2026, as part of its $250 million share repurchase program. The volume-weighted average price paid for these shares was 1,617.18 pence. These repurchased shares are intended for cancellation, and following their cancellation, the company will have 211,711,706 ordinary shares in issue. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 10,174,747 ordinary shares at a total cost of £138,934,752.49. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 211,711,706 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 211,711,706.
